# Statistics

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/statistics.yaml. Do not edit. -->

How a mission is scored. The game counts events per player in six **categories** (`StatAdd(human, group, index, n)`
from scripts; the code adds the same way): each event's count times its **points** (`CfgSetStatValue(group, index,
points)`) makes the category's score, shown as a percentage of the category's **maximum** (`CfgSetStatTypeMax`,
which `global.lua` sets per level from `PointsMatrix`). Harmony counts against the player: its score is the maximum
minus the points ([Inventory, unlockables and statistics](../research/player-state.md#statistics)).

!!! info "What is complete"

    All six categories, all 45 event slots and every level row of `PointsMatrix` are listed. Each event's meaning is
    read from the code that counts it (confirmed (code), one inferred); six slots have no engine caller. How
    `global.lua` turns a level's mission and bonus values into maxima is not traced.

75 entries. Data: `research/references/statistics.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | A category's name, `<group>-<index>` for an event, `level-<n>` for a level. |
| `kind` | str | | `category`, `event` or `level`. |
| `group` | int | | The category's number: `StatAdd`'s group and `CfgSetStatValue`'s table. |
| `category` | str | | Mission, bonus, style, combat, crime or harmony. |
| `index` | int | | The event's index in its category. |
| `meaning` | str | yes | What the game counts there, in our words. |
| `points` | int | | Points per event (`CfgSetStatValue` in `config_preload2.lua`). |
| `max` | int | | The category's default maximum (`CfgSetStatTypeMax` in `config_preload2.lua`). |
| `set_by` | list | | Other scripts that set the event's points. |
| `added_by` | list | | Scripts that count the event with `StatAdd`. |
| `level` | int | | A level's number in `PointsMatrix`. |
| `mission` | float | | The level's mission value (`PointsMatrix`). |
| `bonus` | float | | Its bonus value. |
| `style` | int | | Its style maximum (`Pts.STYLE_*`). |
| `combat` | int | | Its combat maximum (`Pts.COMBAT_*`). |
| `crime` | int | | Its crime maximum (`Pts.CRIME_*`). |
| `harmony` | int | | Its harmony maximum (`Pts.HARM_*`). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
